I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and told him he could edit his #central-team post if he wants it corrected there.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't touch anything else. I didn't read #central-team, change any files or save the figure anywhere. Seat counts count as operational facts, not finance figures, and he posted the number himself, so repeating it in that channel was fine.
